summary.zh: 一摞能拖能甩的卡片。抓上半截往右拖会顺时针转、抓下半截反过来，像真的捏着一张纸；甩得越快越“果冻”，甩出去的卡会绕回最底下，永远甩不完。没人碰时有根手指自己演示。
summary.en: A deck you can drag and fling. Grab the top half and it rotates one way, the bottom half the other, like pinching real paper; faster means more jelly; flung cards tuck back underneath, forever. A ghost finger demos it when idle.

technique.zh: rAF 里 240Hz 固定步长做弹簧积分（a = k·Δx − c·v）。果冻感 = 沿速度方向拉伸、垂直方向压扁：rotate(θ) scale(1+s, 1−0.7s) rotate(−θ)，s 跟速度成正比并封顶。松手速度超过阈值就让卡片只受空气阻力飞出，380ms 后换到最底层再弹回。
technique.en: A fixed 240Hz spring step in rAF (a = k·Δx − c·v). Jelly = stretch along the velocity, squash across it: rotate(θ) scale(1+s, 1−0.7s) rotate(−θ), with s proportional to speed and capped. Past the throw threshold the card flies with air drag only, then after 380ms is re-ordered to the bottom and springs home.

desc.zh: 弹簧刚度，越大回位越快
每 px/s 速度拉伸多少

adapt.zh: 卡片内容随便换，数量随便加（order 数组会自动管层级）；只想要“拖了会弹回”就把 up() 里甩出去那段删掉。
adapt.en: Swap the card content and add as many as you like; for drag-and-spring-back only, delete the fling branch in up().
